rule: never edited by hand; re-fetch from the URL below and re-record provenance
why: rupture implements the two USGS ground-failure models from their published coefficients. The .ini files are the model configuration; the two .py.txt files are the USGS reference implementation and are the machine-readable source of every coefficient rupture uses. They are committed so the coefficient provenance can be checked offline against src/rupture/cascade/coefficients.py.
ref: main branch as of the retrieval time; the repository does not tag releases

jessee_2018.ini.notes: Model configuration for Nowicki Jessee et al. (2018): layer files, refs, slope mask (2-90 deg), minpga 2 %g, maxprob 0.256. Carries no regression coefficients: the operational implementation holds them in gfail/models/jessee_2018.py.

zhu_2017_general.ini.notes: Model configuration for Zhu et al. (2017) general/global model: layer files, refs, slope mask (0-5 deg), minpgv 3 cm/s, minpga 10 %g, vs30max 620 m/s, maxprob 0.487.

jessee_2018.py.txt.notes: Authoritative machine-readable coefficient table for the landslide model (COEFFS, TERMS, CLIPS, COV_COEFFS) and the unconsolidated-sediment substitution (-3.21 -> -1.36). Renamed .py -> .py.txt so ruff/mypy do not lint vendored source.

zhu_2017.py.txt.notes: Authoritative machine-readable coefficient table for the liquefaction model (COEFFS, TERMS, CLIPS, COV_COEFFS) and the magnitude-scaling factor applied to PGV. Renamed .py -> .py.txt so ruff/mypy do not lint vendored source.
